scenes.title: Scene 1: Experience & Skills Hook
scenes.voiceover: You have the experience. You have the skills. Now it's time to take your career to the next level!

scenes.title: Scene 2: Introducing NHIT Durgapur
scenes.voiceover: Introducing NHIT Durgapur – your opportunity to advance through technical education.

scenes.title: Scene 3: Diploma Engineering Branches
scenes.voiceover: Choose your next step. Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, specially offered under the Working Professionals category.

scenes.title: Scene 4: Candidate Eligibility
scenes.voiceover: Are you eligible? If you have the required academic qualification along with a minimum of one year of full-time work experience, this opportunity could be for you.

scenes.title: Scene 5: AICTE & Council Affiliation
scenes.voiceover: We are Affiliated to the West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development and Approved by AICTE for the academic session 2026–27.

scenes.title: Scene 6: Limited Seats & Urgency
scenes.voiceover: Don't stop at experience. Add a qualification to your skills. Hurry up we have limited seats capacity, NHIT brings you an opportunity to strengthen your technical qualifications.

scenes.title: Scene 7: Final Branding & Direct CTA
scenes.voiceover: NHIT Durgapur – Shaping Engineers, Building Futures. Visit www.nhit.in or contact NHIT at +91 98005 71423 for admission details. Your Experience. Your Next Qualification. Your Future.
